facts.fact: The Calabash reports that NCRA's one-year project to bring digital technology to birth and death registration services in communities and health facilities opened with training of health workers and NCRA staff on new software and the distribution of 48 laptops and internet modems to 48 selected health facilities across the 16 districts; the facilities are equipped, none is said to be registering yet, and no date is given, so the document's published date is used.
facts.system: Strengthening Births and Deaths Registration Services within the CRVS System in Sierra Leone

facts.fact: The Calabash reports that the project is backed by a philanthropic grant from the US organisation Vital Strategies Inc., which also pays a quarterly internet subscription for each of the 48 facilities for the project's one year; no amount is given and no date, so the document's published date is used.
facts.system: Strengthening Births and Deaths Registration Services within the CRVS System in Sierra Leone

facts.fact: The Calabash reports that NCRA runs the project through a delivery team set up by its Director General from its finance, procurement, births and deaths, vital statistics, policy, ICT and IEC directorates; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.
facts.system: Strengthening Births and Deaths Registration Services within the CRVS System in Sierra Leone
